sections.release_notes:
## :star: New Features

- Disable variable assignment in SimpleEvaluationContext [#30326](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30326)
- Limit SpEL expression length [#30325](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30325)
- Limit string concatenation in SpEL expressions [#30324](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30324)
- Introduce `StringUtils.truncate()` [#30290](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30290)
- Introduce `ObjectUtils.nullSafeConciseToString()` [#30286](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30286)
- Introduce assertions against `Cookie` attributes in `CookieResultMatchers` for `MockMvc` [#30285](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30285)
- Polishing [#30267](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30267)
- Support `SameSite` cookie attribute in `MockMvcHttpConnector` [#30264](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30264)
- Update `MockCookie` to make use of Servlet 6.0 APIs and semantics for "attributes" [#30263](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30263)
- Refine `initRequestBuilder` in `DefaultWebClient` [#30254](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30254)
- HttpServerErrorException contains not-serializable field of type DefaultResponseErrorHandler  [#30224](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30224)
- Add class hints for Jackson annotations on fields and methods [#30208](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30208)
- Add `HttpMethod` reflection hint to `ObjectToObjectConverterRuntimeHints` [#30201](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30201)
- Improve performance of canRead() in HttpMessageReader's [#30192](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30192)
- Optimize array creation in SpEL `ConstructorReference` [#30189](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30189)
- ConstructorResolver error hints about mixing indexed and named args [#30169](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30169)
- Replace `Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList(..))` with `List.copyOf()` [#30166](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30166)
- Add assert null validations for DefaultServerResponseBuilder [#30157](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30157)
- Use `InputStream.readAllBytes()` in `FileCopyUtils.copyToByteArray()` [#30155](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30155)
- Cache ServerHttpRequest::getMethod in AbstractServerHttpRequest [#30139](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30139)
- Use String.equals() in LiteralPathElement [#30138](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30138)
- Optimize some iterations in BodyExtractor and BodyInserter [#30136](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30136)
- Add a couple missing java.time types to StatementCreatorUtils [#30123](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30123)
- WebClient observations should not record CANCEL signals as aborted if response was received [#30070](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30070)
- Destroy method not found in native image if concrete bean type is not exposed [#29545](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29545)
- Contribute init/destroy lifecycle introspection hints for registered beans [#29246](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/29246)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- NPE thrown for nonexistent `default-destroy-method` in XML config [#30301](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30301)
- Fix comparison of `title` in `equals()` and `hashCode()` of `ProblemDetail` [#30294](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30294)
- SSE breaks with indenting serializer in WebMvc.fn [#30277](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30277)
- `@HttpExchange` interface does not resolve return type correctly while using with suspending methods [#30266](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30266)
- Increase max regex length in SpEL expressions [#30265](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30265)
- Missing response information from client observation context when filter functions fail [#30247](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30247)
- NullPointerException on timeout in HttpComponentsClientHttpConnector when using Apache HttpComponents [#30245](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30245)
- Wrong MockRestRequestMatchers.header() method in spring-test being invoked (JDK issue?) [#30220](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30220)
- Refine generic type management in `AbstractMessageWriterResultHandler` [#30214](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30214)
- MvcUriComponentsBuilder.fromMethodCall breaks for controller with CharSequence return type [#30210](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30210)
- Encode IPV6 Zone IDs (%) in ReactorServerHttpRequest [#30188](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30188)
- Handle all exceptions for stored proc output param retrieval in `SharedEntityManagerCreator` [#30161](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30161)
- Fix IllegalArgumentException that prevents STOMP DISCONNECT from reaching the client [#30120](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30120)
- TypeNotPresentException: org/springframework/cglib/proxy/NoOp not present on Java 17 [#30115](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30115)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Add since tags to sameSite() and attribute() in CookieResultMatchersDsl [#30308](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30308)
- Fix incorrect jakarta.inject artifact version [#30270](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30270)
- Fix `@PathVariable` reference documentation code snippets [#30243](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30243)
- Use diamond operator in examples in reference manual [#30204](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30204)
- Fix example in Javadoc for `@EnableWebSocket` [#30183](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30183)
- Fix anchor in link to "Web on Reactive Stack" chapter [#30158](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30158)
- Documentation for Vavr's Try method to trigger transaction rollbacks [#30108](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/30108)
- Document that WebClient defaultStatusHandler do not apply to exchange\* methods [#30059](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30059)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to Micrometer 1.10.6 [#30317](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30317)
- Upgrade to Reactor 2022.0.6 [#30316](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/30316)
